subject: RE: Encord<>MIRISE
text:
CONFIDENTIAL

Hello Steffan-san,

Alongside the trial, we would also like to proceed with obtaining a cost estimate.
After consulting with our procurement department, we have selected three potential distributors.
The three companies are Hagiwara Techno Solutions, Toyota Tsusho Systems, and Ricoh Japan.
You will likely be contacted by representatives from each company, so we kindly ask for your cooperation in providing them with your quotations.
Below are the service requirements we are currently assuming. If there is any information missing for you to prepare the estimates, please let us know.

Version: Enterprise
Number of Users: 5–10
(If pricing varies depending on the number of users, please provide the estimate based on 5 users.)
Data Volume: Up to 1,000 hours of video data at 5 FPS × 5 cameras
Deployment: Cloud hybrid
(AI development environment built as SaaS, reading and using data stored in our AWS S3)
Functional Requirements:
Data management, curation, annotation, model analysis, versioning—compatible with Vision Language Action Models
Non-functional Requirements:
Enterprise-grade security including SSO, onboarding support via email and Teams, and support/outsourcing for feature customization

Thank you very much for your cooperation.
Kazuyuki Ishihara

This is an opportunity to attend the latest "TechMeetings" event, organised by Choose Paris Region, the economic development agency for Paris. This event will take place on 10th March 2026 in the Paris region and will explore the theme of "Agentic AI, Data & Robotics". You can find more information on the dedicated website.<https://live.eventtia.com/en/agenticaidataroboticstechmeeting/Home/?_cldee=E_CSSG0yO6E4c5bdYvOOFhuCH87081NmSQm6SNEFlIMGsIrfIXP8QJWNlTbC3rsJ&recipientid=contact-5d7a61b308cbec11a7b50022486fa7b8-9ba29868574a4a9789652382cc9286d3&esid=63058b6b-42ed-f011-8406-7ced8d6d1f1d>

TechMeetings are industry-specific open innovation events that bring together international startups, corporate groups that are well-established in the Paris Region, and key players from the local ecosystem.

The event typically takes place over a half-day and includes:

  *   Panel discussions and expert talks
  *   Start-up / scale-up pitches
  *   One-to-one meeting sessions between participating corporate groups and the international start-ups / scale-ups

A select number of international start-ups and scale-ups will be chosen to participate at the event, with the chance to pitch and meet with corporates.

subject: Re: Following up on our 3D Demo Call
text:
Hey Seif,

Thank you for sharing the recording.

To record the highlights from our meeting, current blockers to Encord
handling raw Abyss data include:

   1. Encord can currently render 5-10 million points, whereas Abyss data
   is around 170 million points
   2. By downsampling Abyss data, Encord may be able to handle the data by
   dividing it into batches of scans
   3. Abyss will provide Encord with the downsampling resolution and
   related point counts to test uploading to the platform

@Seif Shoeib <seif@encord.com> please feel free to add anything that I
misunderstood or missed.

Our team is working on gathering the required down-sampling resolution and
point count, which would help us decide whether we can move forward with
Encord 3D labelling. We should have the information you need by next week,
I'll keep you posted.

Regards,
Taha
